stories.title: Mark Carney tells US to ‘start being serious’ amid escalating trade war
bullet_points: Canadian PM is set to retaliate against tariffs levied by Donald Trump and criticized US officials over insults     US politics live – latest updates     Mark Carney has rebuked Donald Trump’s administration and urged officials in Washington to “start being serious” amid escalating trade tensions between the US and Canada.
Days before Canada is due to retaliate against Trump’s sweeping tariffs with its own duties on US goods, the Canadian prime minister criticized US officials for insulting his country.
“It is beneath their office,” he said.

stories.title: MapQuest app reaches No 1 on US Apple list after defying Trump’s Lake Ontario order
bullet_points: Navigating app surpasses Google and Apple Maps on top-downloaded US chart after posting ‘we’re not changing it’  A pioneering online mapping app that defied  Donald Trump  by refusing to  rename  Lake Ontario has become the most in-demand navigation tool in the US.

MapQuest, which was  openly dismissive  of the president’s 27 August executive order  directing federal agencies  to refer to the smallest of the Great Lakes as “Lake America” amid a  trade   spat  with Canada, leapfrogged rivals Google Maps and Apple Maps to top the most-downloaded list, as first reported by  TechCrunch .
